limitations: All six boards contain no saved zone fill (36 unfilled zones total). They are ordinary authored builds, not filled fixtures. No fill, route, role-copper, CAD, tests, CI, role acceptance or geometry investigation was executed in this inspection.

Roles and the read backend remain INFERRED; all six contain zero confirmed roles. The read-card passed state means document reading only, not electrical validation; nine other review cards remain not-run.

Open paths/loops and current-missing findings remain visible/preserved. Buck hot_SW labels 55.230 mm² (good) and 46.126 mm² (bad) coexist with loop-open/area-not-judged warnings. These numerical canvas labels are observations, not validated routed loop area or a good/bad area ordering.

Both half-bridge outputs lack requirements.toml adjacent to the built board and show VBUS roles.limit-missing. The authored source requirements file exists but was not copied into the outputs, so no 400 V spacing/distances were judged. No requirements were added retrospectively.

BMS views show gate hatches but no visible numerical canvas area captions; group names remain available in the sidebar. BMS good shows green Kelvin branches; BMS bad does not show green dashed branches and reports two Kelvin-shared findings. This is a visual observation only; no absent area value was invented.

The fixed normal browser viewport is 1512×751. Role rows can truncate and findings require sidebar scrolling; all actual rows, full messages and codes are preserved in each DOM file. A single screenshot does not simultaneously show every finding.
JPEG is the browser capturer native format; the six originals were saved unchanged and no PNG conversions, reference/golden updates or image edits were made.

No native input, OS automation or Windows/Altium input was used. Only the self-created Chrome localhost tab was used and closed. IAB was unavailable; Chrome fallback was expressly authorized. No file URL, denied URL, re-hosted HTML, personal tabs or JLC session was used.
